initial.phase: Root read the complete controlling printed-source TeX before root primary comparison; the independent reviewer completed a separate source-first study.
initial.scope: Fixed actual W=SU(3)/SO(3), closed 5-manifold, finite simply connected complex rationally S^5. Torus and free 2-rank zero, exact 1 at all odd primes, smooth free C_n for all odd n.
initial.derivation: Homotopy sequence and duality give H_2=Z/2, only other integral homology at 0 and 5. Tangent isotropy rep decomposes real 1+2+2 with rotation weights 1 and 2; spin obstruction detected on pi_2, Sq^1 via mod4 nonliftability, w3 nonzero, top pairing one. Any continuous free involution gives double covering of a topological manifold and pulls back microbundle classes, but even degree annihilates the number; torus restriction excludes all r≥1. Circle diag(z,z,z^-2) fixes points only if a conjugate real determinant-one orthogonal matrix can have eigenvalue1, restricting z to ±1. Odd rank-two would have two-row Borel sequence and only one transgression cubic after exterior quotient, giving unbounded graded pieces and impossible finite-dimensional quotient cohomology.
initial.limits: Hanke actual fixed space and free ranks, no gap for almost free versions, no proof of priority, earlier Wu obstruction and cyclic finite-vs-circle gaps deserve credit.

math: The closed smooth five-dimensional Wu manifold is simply connected with H2=Z/2 and only H0 and H5 otherwise. Rational Hurewicz/Whitehead identify the rational homotopy type of S5. The tangent isotropy weights 1,2 give nonzero w2; coefficient Bockstein gives w3 and Poincare pairing is one. For arbitrary continuous free involution the quotient is a closed topological manifold and tangent microbundle pulls back. The covering degree is zero mod2, contradicting the nonzero characteristic number. A free positive-dimensional torus would restrict to a free involution. The diagonal circle weights 1,1,-2 force stabilizers to lie in {±1}, hence every odd cyclic subgroup acts freely. Odd rank-two would give a two-row Borel sequence whose bottom quotient surjects onto a two-variable polynomial ring mod at most one binary cubic. Unbounded cohomological degrees contradict the five-dimensional free quotient. No extensions, exterior terms or zero transgression remove this issue.
